content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGIMS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS), located in Patna, Bihar, for filling up medical professional positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this IGIMS notification?
faq.answer: The post announced under this recruitment notification is Senior Resident specifically for the Cardio Thoracic & Vascular Surgery department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IGIMS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Senior Resident position under this recruitment drive at IGIMS Patna.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for IGIMS Senior Resident jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the specified date with required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 07-10-2026. Candidates must report at the venue as per the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess MS/DNB in General Surgery or M.Ch/DNB in CTVS along with necessary registration with the Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for IGIMS Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC/ST, EBC/BC, and female candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67700/- plus NPA and usual allowances as per institutional norms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for UR/EWS/BC/EBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR, EWS, BC, and EBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-, payable via Demand Draft in favor of The Director, IGIMS, Patna.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at the HOD Chamber, Department of CTVS, Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna-800014.
